summary.headline: 3 item(s) need manual review; no blocking issue detected

findings.title: Target SDK is computed (flutter.targetSdkVersion) – verify it meets API 36
findings.explanation: targetSdk comes from the Flutter Gradle plugin, so it depends on the installed Flutter SDK version. Google Play requires API 36 or higher for phone-tablet apps since 2026-08-31.

evidence.description: Target SDK is computed, not a literal

findings.recommendation: Check the merged value (e.g. inspect the built AAB with `bundletool dump manifest`) or set targetSdk explicitly to 36 or higher after testing the behavior changes.

references.title: Meet Google Play's target API level requirement
Target API level requirements for Google Play apps (Play Console Help)

findings.title: No privacy policy found in the project
findings.explanation: Both stores require a privacy policy link in the store listing (App Store Connect and Play Console), and Google Play requires it to also be accessible in the app when the app handles personal data. The scanner found no policy URL or document, but the link may only exist in the store consoles.

evidence.description: No app.privacy_policy_url, fastlane privacy_url.txt, privacy URL in code, or privacy policy document found

findings.recommendation: Record the policy URL as app.privacy_policy_url in .release-doctor.yml and link it from inside the app (e.g. Settings > Privacy).

references.title: App Review Guidelines 5.1.1 – Data Collection and Storage
App privacy details on the App Store
Provide information for Google Play's Data safety section

findings.title: Account creation could not be determined
findings.explanation: No authentication SDK or sign-up flow was found, so the scanner cannot tell whether account deletion is required. Absence of evidence is not proof that the app has no accounts (for example, accounts created through a web view or a custom backend).

evidence.description: No auth dependency, sign-up call or sign-up label found in app sources

findings.recommendation: Set app.has_account_creation in .release-doctor.yml. If the app lets users create accounts, it must offer in-app account deletion.
